data.name: MWG_001
data.value: The summit...[pause=15] We're almost there.

data.name: MWG_002
data.value: Look at the sky...[pause=15] Those clouds aren't normal.

data.name: MWG_003
data.value: Is that...[pause=10] a storm?!

data.name: MWG_004
data.value: An...[pause=10] AN AERODACTYL!

data.name: MWG_005
data.value: The Ancient Sky Predator...

data.name: MWG_006
data.value: You...[pause=10] You knew it was here!

data.name: MWG_007
data.value: The mountain's ultimate guardian.[pause=20] It ruled these skies long before anyone set foot on this land.

data.name: MWG_008
data.value: If you triumph here, the path to the ancestral ruins will open to you.

data.name: MWG_009
data.value: Fail...[pause=30] and your journey ends here.

data.name: MWG_010
data.value: Then let's show it our journey is just beginning![pause=10] [player], let's do this!

data.name: MWG_011
data.value: This time, we take it down.[pause=15] I promise, [player].

data.name: MWG_012
data.value: We...[pause=10] We beat it!

data.name: MWG_013
data.value: Look![pause=10] The storm is clearing...

data.name: MWG_014
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It said something about ancestral ruins.

data.name: MWG_015
data.value: That's where we're going.[pause=20] To the Cloven Ruins.

data.name: MWG_016
data.value: Then let's go![pause=15] The end of the expedition awaits us!

data.name: MWG_017
data.value: The ancient predator shows no mercy...

data.name: MWG_018
data.value: But today's prey is tomorrow's hunter.

data.name: MWG_019
data.value: Rest now.[pause=30] The summit will wait for you.

data.name: MWG_020
data.value: I...[pause=5] I can't stand anymore...[pause=15] The Aerodactyl is too powerful!

data.name: MWG_021
data.value: The Aerodactyl lets out a piercing screech that tears through the sky.[pause=15] It towers over you.

data.name: MWG_022
data.value: You are not the first to fall,[pause=20] little climber.[pause=25] And you won't be the last.

data.name: MWG_023
data.value: It rises back into the storm with two wingbeats.[pause=20] The mountain still trembles.

data.name: MWG_024
data.value: The ancient predator collapses in a cloud of dust.[pause=15] The storm clears.

data.name: MWG_025
data.value: The Aerodactyl looks at you, panting.[pause=20] Then it lowers its head.

data.name: MWG_026
data.value: You have defeated the king of these skies.[pause=25] I... I never thought I'd see this.[pause=30] Go. The summit is yours.

data.name: MWG_027
data.value: It spreads its wings one last time and disappears into the clouds.[pause=15] Silence returns.

data.name: MWG_028
data.value: We...[pause=10] WE BEAT IT![pause=15] The summit is ours!

data.name: MWG_029
data.value: The oldest predator bows before you.[pause=25] You are changing the rules of this world.

data.name: MWG_030
data.value: That storm isn't weather. It's been waiting for us.

data.name: MWG_031
data.value: Whatever lands here, we don't run. Agreed?

data.name: MWG_032
data.value: Agreed. Though my legs may need convincing.

data.name: MWG_033
data.value: This one remembers a sky without climbers in it.

data.name: MWG_034
data.value: Then it's had a long time to get used to disappointment.

data.name: MWG_035
data.value: It folds its wings. The storm folds with it.

data.name: MWG_036
data.value: We came up here for the expedition. I'd forgotten that.

data.name: MWG_037
data.value: So had I. Somewhere on the way it became something else.

data.name: MWG_R01
data.value: The wind is still just as sharp up here.[pause=20] But the sky is empty.

data.name: MWG_R02
data.value: (No shadow crossing the sun.[pause=15] No cry against the rock.)

data.name: MWG_R03
data.value: He must be nesting higher up now.[pause=20] Somewhere we'll never reach.

data.name: MWG_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: MWG_038
data.value: I saw you from the ridge.[pause=25] Two specks, climbing badly.

data.name: MWG_039
data.value: I have watched this land from above since before it had roads.

data.name: MWG_040
data.value: From up there you stop seeing places.[pause=25] You start seeing shapes.

data.name: MWG_041
data.value: And there is a shape under your world, little ones.[pause=30] It has corners.

data.name: MWG_042
data.value: Nothing natural has corners.

data.name: MWG_043
data.value: I have carried that on my back for a very long time.[pause=30] Show me you can carry it too.

data.name: MWG_044
data.value: Then it is yours now.[pause=30] I am glad. It was heavy.

data.name: MWG_045
data.value: Go down. Sleep. Eat something.[pause=25] Nobody solves a shape on an empty stomach.

data.name: MWG_046
data.value: And when you find the corners —[pause=30] do not assume they were built to keep you OUT.

data.name: MWG_051
data.value: It's...[pause=15] it's looking at us.

data.name: MWG_052
data.value: (I've never seen anything like this.[pause=20] It's...[pause=15] immense.)

data.name: MWG_053
data.value: Why have you come here?

data.name: MWG_054
data.value: We...[pause=15] we're part of the guild.[pause=20] We're on an expedition.

data.name: MWG_055
data.value: The guild.[pause=20] More climbers.[pause=25] Always the same.

data.name: MWG_056
data.value: Do you even know where you're setting foot?

data.name: MWG_057
data.value: We don't mean any harm![pause=20] We're just trying to understand what's happening in this region.

data.name: MWG_058
data.value: Understand?[pause=25] You climb,[pause=15] you take,[pause=15] you leave.[pause=20] That's all you know how to do.

data.name: MWG_059
data.value: (It's angry...[pause=20] But why?[pause=25] What did we do?)

data.name: MWG_060
data.value: This summit is not a trophy.[pause=25] This wind is not a spectacle.

data.name: MWG_061
data.value: How long do you think I've been blowing here?

data.name: MWG_062
data.value: I...[pause=15] I don't know...

data.name: MWG_063
data.value: Since before your roads.[pause=25] Before your guilds.[pause=25] Before your names.

data.name: MWG_064
data.value: And you arrive.[pause=20] Without asking.[pause=20] Without listening.

data.name: MWG_065
data.value: We ARE listening![pause=20] That's why we climbed![pause=25] Something is wrong in this region and we want to know what!

data.name: MWG_066
data.value: ...You're looking for the angles.

data.name: MWG_067
data.value: The...[pause=15] the what?

data.name: MWG_068
data.value: Nothing natural has angles.[pause=30] And yet they are there.[pause=25] Beneath your world.

data.name: MWG_069
data.value: I don't know if you are a threat...[pause=25] or a hope.

data.name: MWG_070
data.value: So I will find out.

data.name: MWG_080
data.value: You resist the wind.[pause=20] Interesting.

data.name: MWG_081
data.value: Perhaps you are not like the others.[pause=25] Perhaps.

data.name: MWG_082
data.value: Very well.[pause=20] Show me what you're truly worth.

data.name: MWG_083
data.value: This wind...[pause=25] is all I have left.
